question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Punishment** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Punishment **means the imposition of a penalty or consequence for wrongdoing, typically as a form of retribution, deterrence, or rehabilitation. (गलत कार्य के लिए दंड या परिणाम देना) • **Example**: *If someone is convicted of theft, a common punishment might be a fine or imprisonment.* • In this context, "**punishment**" is used to convey the broader concept of penalizing individuals for their actions, and "**capital punishment**" is a specific and severe type of punishment within that framework. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Loss: **Reduction or decrease in something valuable or desirable. (किसी मूल्यवान या वांछनीय वस्तु में कमी) • **Gain: **Increase or acquisition of something valuable or desirable. (किसी मूल्यवान या वांछनीय वस्तु की वृद्धि या प्राप्ति) • **Attainment: **The act of achieving or reaching a goal or objective. (किसी लक्ष्य या उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने या उस तक पहुँचने की क्रिया) 3e:T92f, The correct answer is: **Existence**
